concept.hr: Lociranje DC-a preko DNS SRV, zatim Kerberos; bez DC-a spremljene vjerodajnice
concept.en: DC locator via DNS SRV, then Kerberos; cached credentials when no DC answers

summary.hr: Prijavi se u HQ-u, u podružnici s RODC-om i izvan mreže: SRV upit, LDAP ping i lokacija, Kerberos; bez DC-a samo tko se već prijavljivao.
summary.en: Log on in HQ, at a branch with an RODC, and offline: SRV query, LDAP ping and site, Kerberos; with no DC, only users seen before get in.
